newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA SAY INTER HAVE NOT OFFERED ENOUGH FOR RONALDO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA SAY INTER HAVE NOT OFFERED ENOUGH FOR RONALDO.

text.p: A Barcelona club official was reported on Wednesday as saying that agreement over the Ronaldo transfer between the Spanish giants and Inter Milan broke down because the Italian club did not offer enough money.

Joan Gaspart, a Barcelona vice-president, was quoted in Spanish sports paper Marca as saying: "Inter are the problem because they are not prepared to pay more than four billion pesetas ($26.6 million)."
The sport's governing body, FIFA, have ruled that Inter legitimately paid Barcelona to buy out Ronaldo's contract.
The Catalan club are reported to want a further 2.2 billion pesetas ($14.6 million) as a transfer fee while Inter have apparently offered only 100 million pesetas ($660,000).
FIFA are set to rule on the dispute on Thursday if the two clubs cannot agree.
"One thing is sure...it is not possible for Ronaldo to return to Barcelona," Gaspart said.
